answer.feedback: Accept the Monod rate law, r = theta1*x2/(theta2 + x2).
answer.reasoning: C9 fits within the noise (chi2 118.2 < 148.8), and every parameter is estimated precisely (all t-values exceed 1). It also has the higher Akaike weight among the fitting candidates. C40 has an effectively unbounded Ki, so its extra parameter is not meaningfully identified.
